format: UCWDC contests, competitor check-in before a division's first heat

source.quote_free_summary: For heated divisions competitors should report to the Floor Coordinator thirty minutes before the division's first heat, earlier if the event schedule says so.

requirement: A future UCWDC profile may treat a division's first heat pulled earlier than this lead time from its announced time as an acknowledgment finding; the language is 'should', so it is never a hard blocker.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation.
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Recommended, not mandatory; needs the time model.
